name: Hybrids
author: gcrabtree
about: Three worlds that mix two kinds of fold: tetrahedra strung with beads, a cage of bubbles, a sponge folded back on itself. With a journey through all three.

worlds.name: Folded sponge
worlds.code: vec3 z=p;float d=-1e5;float s=1.0;float L=0.75+0.08*m;orb=vec4(1000.0);for(int i=0;i<4;i++){vec3 a=mod(z,2.0)-1.0;if(i==1||i==3){a=clamp(a,-L,L)*2.0-a;a/=L;s/=L;}s*=3.0;vec3 r=abs(1.0-3.0*abs(a));orb=min(orb,vec4(abs(a),dot(a,a)*0.4));d=max(d,(min(max(r.x,r.y),min(max(r.y,r.z),max(r.z,r.x)))-1.0)/s);z=a*3.0;}return d*0.9;
